title: Create tests/agile package structure
body:
Create the directory `tests/agile/` with an empty `__init__.py` so test discovery works. This mirrors the source layout.

**Done when:** `tests/agile/__init__.py` exists and pytest discovers it.

votes.justification: Creating a directory with an empty __init__.py is a one-command operation with no design risk or code complexity. From an architecture perspective, this is purely a mechanical setup task that follows the established pattern.
Creating an empty __init__.py file is trivial — no logic to test, no risk of breakage. Verification is immediate by running pytest discovery.
Creating an empty __init__.py file is trivial and poses no security risk. No credentials or sensitive patterns can be introduced in an empty file.
